l09-gratin-courgettes-feta-menthe.t: Zucchini Gratin with Feta and Mint
s: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Cut the zucchini into thin slices and sauté them with the garlic in the oil for 6 minutes to draw out their water.
Beat the eggs with the cream, mint and pepper (no salt, as the feta is salty).
Arrange the zucchini in a baking dish, scatter over the feta and pour the egg mixture on top.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the gratin is set and golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
l09-gratin-courgettes-feta-menthe.p: Delicious served warm with grilled lamb chops.

s: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Cut all the vegetables into 3 cm pieces and the onion into wedges.
In a large bowl, toss them with the oil, ras el hanout and salt.
Spread on a large baking sheet in a single layer and roast for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro just before serving.
l09-legumes-rotis-ras-el-hanout.p: Use two baking sheets if needed: crowded vegetables steam instead of roasting.

s: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Trim the sprouts and cut them in half lengthwise.
Toss with the oil, chopped garlic, salt and pepper, then place them cut side down on the baking sheet.
Roast for 20 minutes, sprinkle with Parmesan and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice before serving.
l09-choux-bruxelles-rotis-parmesan.p: The cut side caramelizes against the sheet and mellows the flavor: perfect for winning kids over to Brussels sprouts.

l09-brocoli-roti-ail-amandes.t: Roasted Broccoli with Garlic and Almonds
s: Preheat the oven to 220°C.
Cut the broccoli into florets; peel the stalk and cut it into slices.
Toss with the oil, salt and chili flakes, and spread on a baking sheet. Roast for 12 minutes.
Add the garlic and almonds, toss, and continue roasting for 6 to 8 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon and serve.
l09-brocoli-roti-ail-amandes.p: Garlic added partway through cooking doesn't burn and stays fragrant.

l09-poelee-champignons-persillade.t: Sautéed Mushrooms with Garlic and Parsley
s: Clean the mushrooms with a damp paper towel and cut them into quarters.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat and sauté the mushrooms for 8 minutes without salting, until golden.
Add the butter and the garlic and parsley chopped together, and stir for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.
l09-poelee-champignons-persillade.p: Salting at the end keeps the mushrooms from releasing their water and boiling.

s: Trim the beans and cook them in salted boiling water for 6 to 7 minutes: they should stay crisp.
Drain and plunge them into ice water to set the color, then drain again.
In a skillet, melt the butter until foamy and brown the almonds for 2 minutes.
Add the beans, sauté for 3 minutes, drizzle with lemon, and season with salt and pepper.
l09-haricots-verts-amandine.p: The blanched beans can be prepared the day before; all that's left at mealtime is 5 minutes in the pan.

s: Melt the butter in a sauté pan and cook the chopped garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the spinach by the handful and let it wilt for 3 to 4 minutes; discard the liquid it releases.
Add the cream, nutmeg and Parmesan, and let reduce for 3 minutes over medium heat.
Season with salt and pepper and serve piping hot.
l09-epinards-creme-ail.p: If using frozen spinach, squeeze it well with your hands to remove the water before adding it.

l09-salade-chou-rouge-coleslaw.t: Keto Red and White Cabbage Coleslaw
s: Slice the cabbages very thinly with a knife or mandoline.
Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, vinegar, mustard, erythritol, salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrot and toss well.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving so the cabbage softens.
l09-salade-chou-rouge-coleslaw.p: Keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator. Perfect with grilled chicken or skewers.

l09-salade-concombre-yaourt-menthe.t: Cucumber Salad with Yogurt and Mint
s: Cut the cucumbers into thin half-moons, salt them lightly and let them drain for 10 minutes; drain well.
Mix the yogurt with the grated garlic and chopped mint.
Add the cucumbers and mix gently.
Serve chilled with a drizzle of olive oil.
l09-salade-concombre-yaourt-menthe.p: Refreshing alongside a spicy dish or grilled kefta.

s: Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet for 3 minutes, then roughly chop them.
Whisk together the oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Place the arugula and the halved cherry tomatoes in a salad bowl.
Dress at the last moment, then add the Parmesan shavings and walnuts.
l09-salade-roquette-parmesan-noix.p: Shave the Parmesan with a vegetable peeler directly over the salad.

l09-salade-avocat-tomate-oignon-rouge.t: Avocado, Tomato and Red Onion Salad
s: Thinly slice the red onion and let it marinate in the lemon juice for 5 minutes to mellow it.
Dice the tomatoes and avocados.
Gently toss with the onion and its lemon juice, the oil and the cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.
l09-salade-avocat-tomate-oignon-rouge.p: The lemon keeps the avocado from browning; prepare it no more than 1 hour ahead.

s: Cook the cauliflower florets in salted water for 8 minutes: they should stay slightly firm. Drain and let cool.
Cook the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them and peel them.
Cut the eggs, gherkins and celery into small dice.
Mix the mayonnaise and mustard, then add all the ingredients and the chives; season with salt and pepper.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.
l09-salade-chou-fleur-facon-pommes-de-te.p: Slightly firm cauliflower really gives the illusion of potato. Ideal for picnics.

l09-courgettes-sautees-ail-menthe.t: Sautéed Zucchini with Garlic and Mint
s: Cut the zucchini into 5 mm half-moons.
Heat the oil over high heat in a large skillet and sauté the zucchini for 6 minutes in a single layer.
Add the minced garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Off the heat, add the chopped mint and the lemon; season with salt and pepper.
l09-courgettes-sautees-ail-menthe.p: Cook in two batches if the pan is small so the zucchini brown instead of releasing their water.

s: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus.
Arrange them on a baking sheet, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and roast for 10 to 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter with the lemon zest and juice.
Pour the lemon butter over the asparagus and sprinkle with Parmesan.
l09-asperges-roties-beurre-citron.p: Perfect with grilled fish or poached eggs.

l09-navets-glaces-cumin.t: Roasted Turnips with Cumin and Parsley
s: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Peel the turnips and cut them into wedges.
Toss them with the oil, cumin, crushed garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through, until golden and tender.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
l09-navets-glaces-cumin.p: When roasted, turnips lose their bitterness and taste a bit like pan-fried potatoes.

l09-chou-blanc-poele-beurre.t: Pan-Fried Cabbage with Butter and Cumin
s: Slice the cabbage into 1 cm strips and the onion thinly.
Melt the butter in a large sauté pan and add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add the onion, then the cabbage, and sauté for 12 to 15 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring often, until tender and lightly caramelized.
Season with salt and pepper.
l09-chou-blanc-poele-beurre.p: Cabbage is one of the most budget-friendly keto vegetables. Add diced cachir (beef deli meat) for a more complete dish.

l09-champignons-farcis-chevre.t: Goat Cheese and Herb Stuffed Mushrooms
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Remove the mushroom stems and chop them finely.
Sauté the chopped stems and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes.
Mix with the goat cheese, herbs, walnuts and pepper.
Fill the mushroom caps, place them on a baking sheet and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
l09-champignons-farcis-chevre.p: Serve as an appetizer or alongside a roast. They can be prepared ahead and baked at the last minute.

l09-puree-brocoli-parmesan.t: Broccoli and Cauliflower Purée with Parmesan
s: Steam the broccoli and cauliflower florets for 12 minutes.
Drain thoroughly and let dry for 2 minutes.
Blend with the butter, cream cheese and Parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
l09-puree-brocoli-parmesan.p: A green purée that kids happily eat; serve it with almond-flour chicken nuggets.

l09-salade-fenouil-olives-citron.t: Fennel, Black Olive and Lemon Salad
s: Slice the fennel as thinly as possible with a mandoline.
Immediately drizzle with the lemon juice and oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Add the olives and chopped parsley and toss.
Let rest for 15 minutes before serving to soften the fennel.
l09-salade-fenouil-olives-citron.p: Fresh and crunchy, it pairs perfectly with grilled sea bream or sea bass.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Mix the grated Parmesan with the smoked paprika, garlic powder and pepper.
Drop heaping tablespoon-sized mounds 5 cm apart, then flatten them slightly into 6 cm discs.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until the edges are golden and the crisps stop bubbling.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet: they harden as they cool. Gently loosen them with a spatula.
l10-chips-parmesan-paprika.p: For tuiles, drape the still-warm crisps over a rolling pin. They keep for 5 days in an airtight container.

l10-oeufs-mimosa-thon-harissa.t: Deviled Eggs with Tuna and Harissa
s: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool them in ice water for 5 minutes.
Peel the eggs, cut them in half lengthwise and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with a fork with the flaked tuna, mayonnaise, harissa, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Fill the whites with the mixture using a spoon or piping bag, forming a dome.
Sprinkle with parsley and chill for at least 20 minutes before serving.
l10-oeufs-mimosa-thon-harissa.p: Adjust the harissa to suit the kids: make half the batch without chili. They keep for 24 hours in the refrigerator, covered with plastic wrap.

l10-rouleaux-dinde-fromage-concombre.t: Smoked Turkey, Cream Cheese and Cucumber Roll-Ups
s: Mix the cream cheese with the chives and pepper.
Cut the cucumber into sticks as wide as the turkey slices, removing the seeds.
Spread a thin layer of cheese on each turkey slice.
Place a cucumber stick at the edge and roll up tightly. Secure with a toothpick if needed.
Chill for 15 minutes, then cut in half for an appetizer.
l10-rouleaux-dinde-fromage-concombre.p: Vary with a bell pepper stick or an arugula leaf. Ideal for lunchboxes, kept well chilled.

s: Steam the cauliflower for 12 to 15 minutes, until very tender. Drain and let cool slightly.
Blend the cauliflower with the tahini, 2 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt until creamy and smooth.
Taste and adjust the lemon and salt. Refrigerate for 30 minutes: the hummus will thicken.
Cut the cucumber, celery and bell pepper into 8 cm sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a bowl, make a well in the center, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with paprika. Serve with the veggie sticks.
l10-houmous-chou-fleur-tahini.p: Keeps for 4 days in the refrigerator. For a more roasted flavor, roast the cauliflower for 25 minutes at 210°C instead of steaming it.

l10-noix-epicees-ras-el-hanout.t: Ras el Hanout Roasted Nut Mix
s: Preheat the oven to 160°C.
Beat the egg white with a fork until lightly frothy.
Add the nuts and coat them well, then sprinkle with the ras el hanout, cayenne and salt. Toss.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the nuts are dry and fragrant.
Let cool completely: the coating turns crunchy as it cools.
l10-noix-epicees-ras-el-hanout.p: Recommended portion: a small handful (40 g). Keeps for 3 weeks in a jar.

l10-fat-bombs-salees-ciboulette-noix.t: Savory Cream Cheese, Chive and Walnut Fat Bombs
s: Work the cream cheese and softened butter together with a fork until creamy.
Stir in the cheddar, 1 tbsp of the chives, the garlic powder and the pepper.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm up the mixture.
Finely chop the walnuts and mix them with the remaining chives on a plate.
Shape 12 walnut-sized balls and roll them in the walnut-chive mixture.
Chill for at least 1 hour before enjoying.
l10-fat-bombs-salees-ciboulette-noix.p: Keeps for 5 days in the refrigerator. Variation: roll them in toasted sesame seeds or paprika.

l10-brochettes-halloumi-tomates.t: Grilled Halloumi and Cherry Tomato Skewers
s: Cut the halloumi into 16 cubes of 2 cm and the zucchini into thick half-moons.
Mix the oil, oregano and lemon juice, then coat the cheese and vegetables with it.
Thread onto 8 small skewers, alternating halloumi, tomato and zucchini.
Grill for 6 to 8 minutes on a grill pan or very hot barbecue, turning, until the halloumi is golden.
Sprinkle with mint and serve immediately; halloumi hardens as it cools.
l10-brochettes-halloumi-tomates.p: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes so they don't burn.

l10-tartinade-jben-herbes.t: Jben Herb Spread with Olive Oil
s: Drain the jben in a fine strainer for 10 minutes if it releases whey.
Mash it with a fork with 1 tbsp olive oil, the grated garlic, salt and pepper.
Stir in the parsley, cilantro and mint.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with za'atar.
Serve with the halved radishes and thickly sliced cucumber, or on seed crackers.
l10-tartinade-jben-herbes.p: Eat within 3 days. Add a few chopped black olives for a bolder flavor.

l10-dip-avocat-feta.t: Creamy Avocado-Feta Dip with Crunchy Veggies
s: Scoop the flesh of the avocados into a blender bowl.
Add the crumbled feta, Greek yogurt, lemon juice and pepper. Blend until creamy and smooth.
Fold in the dill with a spoon and taste: the feta is already salty, so add salt only if needed.
Cut the celery and bell pepper into sticks and serve around the dip.
l10-dip-avocat-feta.p: To keep it from browning, press plastic wrap directly onto the surface. Keeps for 24 hours in the refrigerator.

l10-boulettes-kefta-cocktail.t: Mini Mint Kefta Meatballs with Yogurt Sauce
s: Mix the kefta with the well-squeezed grated onion, the parsley, half of the mint, the spices and the salt. Knead for 2 minutes.
With oiled hands, shape about thirty walnut-sized meatballs.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the meatballs for 8 to 10 minutes, rolling them, until golden and cooked through to the center (70°C).
Mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon juice, the remaining mint and a pinch of salt.
Skewer each meatball with a toothpick and serve hot with the yogurt sauce.
l10-boulettes-kefta-cocktail.p: Raw meatballs can be frozen flat on a baking sheet and then bagged. Cook them from frozen, adding 2 minutes.

s: Preheat the oven to 120°C (fan).
Cut the zucchini into very thin (2 mm) slices with a mandoline.
Spread them on paper towels, salt lightly and let drain for 10 minutes, then blot them dry.
Brush with oil, arrange without overlapping on two baking sheets and sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, checking from 35 minutes: remove the golden chips as they are done.
Let them crisp up for 10 minutes on a rack.
l10-chips-courgette-parmesan.p: They soften with humidity: enjoy them the same day, or put them back in the oven for 5 minutes.

l10-bouchees-thon-avocat-concombre.t: Cucumber Bites with Tuna and Avocado Tartare
s: Cut the cucumber into thick 1.5 cm slices and scoop out a little of the center with a melon baller.
Drain and flake the tuna. Cut the avocado into tiny dice and toss with lemon juice.
Gently mix the tuna, avocado, mayonnaise, chives, salt and pepper.
Spoon a little tartare onto each cucumber slice, sprinkle with paprika and serve chilled.
l10-bouchees-thon-avocat-concombre.p: Make the tartare up to 2 hours ahead, but top the cucumbers at the last minute so they stay crunchy.

s: Cook the eggs in boiling water for 10 minutes, then plunge them into ice water for 5 minutes and peel them.
Cut them in half and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with the avocado flesh, lime juice, salt and chili until smooth and creamy.
Fill the whites using a piping bag with a star tip.
Garnish with cilantro and serve quickly.
l10-oeufs-mimosa-avocat.p: Kids' version: no chili, with a pinch of cumin. Serve within 6 hours.

s: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the almond flour, flaxseed, Parmesan, rosemary and salt, then add the egg and knead into a ball.
Roll the dough out between two sheets of parchment paper to 2 to 3 mm thick.
Remove the top sheet, cut into rectangles with a knife and prick with a fork.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the edges are well browned.
Separate the crackers and let them cool on a rack: they turn crisp.
l10-crackers-parmesan-lin.p: Keep for a week in a metal tin. Delicious with the jben spread or tzatziki.

l10-olives-marinees-citron-confit.t: Marinated Olives with Preserved Lemon and Harissa
s: Rinse the olives in cold water and drain well.
Cut the preserved lemon rind into thin strips, after removing the pulp.
Mix the olive oil, harissa, garlic, cumin and cilantro.
Add the olives and preserved lemon and mix well.
Marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator, ideally overnight, stirring occasionally.
l10-olives-marinees-citron-confit.p: They keep for 10 days in the refrigerator in a jar, covered with oil. Take them out 20 minutes before serving.

s: Preheat the oven to 210°C. Cut the chicken into 3 cm cubes.
Marinate for 10 minutes with the soy sauce, ginger and pepper.
Beat the egg in a shallow dish; mix the sesame seeds and almond flour in another.
Dip each cube in the egg, then roll it in the sesame mixture.
Place on an oiled baking sheet, drizzle with a little oil and bake for 14 to 16 minutes, turning halfway through.
Serve hot with homemade aioli or keto ketchup.
l10-bouchees-poulet-sesame.p: Check for doneness: the meat should be white all the way through (70°C at the center). Reheat for 5 minutes in the oven, not the microwave.

s: Cut the halloumi into 1.5 cm thick sticks and pat them dry.
Roll them in the coconut flour mixed with half of the za'atar, patting off the excess.
Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown the sticks for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until crispy.
Drain on paper towels, drizzle with lemon, sprinkle with the remaining za'atar and serve immediately.
l10-halloumi-frites-zaatar.p: Serve with tzatziki or the garlic white sauce.

l10-tartinade-sardines-citron.t: Sardine Rillettes with Lemon and Cream Cheese
i: cans of sardines in oil, drained
s: Drain the sardines and remove the central bone if you like.
Mash them with a fork with the cream cheese, mustard, lemon juice and cumin.
Add the parsley, season generously with pepper and mix.
Pack into a ramekin and chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with celery sticks or on seed crackers.
l10-tartinade-sardines-citron.p: Budget-friendly and rich in omega-3s. Keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator.

l10-baba-ganoush-keto.t: Smoky Eggplant Dip with Tahini (Baba Ganoush)
s: Prick the eggplants and char them directly over a gas flame or under the oven broiler at 240°C for 30 to 35 minutes, turning them, until the skin is blackened and the flesh is soft.
Place them in a covered bowl for 10 minutes, then peel off the skin and drain the flesh in a colander for 10 minutes.
Mash the flesh with a fork with the tahini, lemon juice, grated garlic, cumin and salt.
Spoon into a shallow dish, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with smoked paprika and parsley.
Serve with the radishes and veggie sticks.
l10-baba-ganoush-keto.p: Charring over a flame gives the smoky taste; in the oven, add a little more smoked paprika.

l10-roules-courgette-chevre.t: Grilled Zucchini Roll-Ups with Goat Cheese and Basil
s: Slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin 3 mm strips with a mandoline.
Brush them with oil and grill for 1 to 2 minutes per side in a very hot grill pan. Let cool flat.
Mix the goat cheese with the chopped basil, salt and pepper.
Spread a teaspoon of goat cheese on each strip, sprinkle with almonds and roll up tightly.
Secure with a toothpick and serve at room temperature.
l10-roules-courgette-chevre.p: Prepare the strips the day before and keep them chilled between two sheets of parchment paper.

l10-noix-pecan-cannelle-salees.t: Sugar-Free Caramelized Pecans and Almonds with a Touch of Salt
s: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the pecans and almonds and toast for 5 minutes, stirring.
Sprinkle with the erythritol and cinnamon and stir constantly for 2 to 3 minutes, until coated and glossy.
Immediately spread on parchment paper, sprinkle with flaky salt and separate them with a fork.
Let cool for 15 minutes before enjoying.
l10-noix-pecan-cannelle-salees.p: A small handful is enough (25 g). Keep for 2 weeks in a jar.

l10-mayonnaise-maison.t: Foolproof Homemade Mayonnaise with an Immersion Blender
s: Take the egg out of the refrigerator 30 minutes ahead: all the ingredients should be at the same temperature.
In a tall, narrow glass just slightly wider than the blender, put the egg, mustard, lemon juice and salt, then pour the oil on top.
Lower the blender to the bottom, turn it on and don't move it for 10 seconds: the mayonnaise forms from the bottom up.
Very slowly lift the blender to incorporate the rest of the oil, in about 20 seconds.
Taste, add pepper and adjust the lemon. Transfer to a clean jar.
l10-mayonnaise-maison.p: Keeps for 4 days in the refrigerator in a closed jar. Use only a very fresh egg. Contains raw eggs: not recommended for pregnant women, children under 5, or elderly or vulnerable people.

s: Peel the garlic, remove the germ and crush it into a fine paste in a mortar with the salt.
Add the egg yolks and mix with the pestle or a whisk for 30 seconds.
Pour in the mixed oils in a thin stream, whisking constantly, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Add the lemon juice at the end, whisking, then adjust the seasoning.
Chill for at least 30 minutes so the garlic flavor infuses.
l10-aioli-provencal.p: If the aioli splits, start over with a fresh yolk and gradually whisk in the broken sauce. Perfect with grilled fish and steamed vegetables. Contains raw eggs: not recommended for pregnant women, children under 5, or elderly or vulnerable people.

l10-pesto-basilic-amandes.t: Basil Pesto with Almonds and Parmesan
s: Toast the almonds in a dry skillet for 3 minutes, then let cool.
Blend the almonds and garlic into a coarse powder.
Add the basil, Parmesan, lemon juice and salt and pulse.
Pour in the oil in a stream with the blender running, until you have a sauce that still has some texture.
Transfer to a jar and cover with a thin layer of oil.
l10-pesto-basilic-amandes.p: Pesto darkens when exposed to air: always cover it with oil. It freezes very well in ice cube trays.

s: Grate the garlic very finely with a microplane.
Whisk the Greek yogurt with the mayonnaise until smooth.
Add the garlic, lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper, then the parsley.
Chill for at least 1 hour so the garlic flavor spreads.
l10-sauce-blanche-ail.p: Ideal with chicken skewers or kefta. Keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator.

s: In a saucepan, sauté the crushed garlic in the oil for 1 minute over medium heat.
Add the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, vinegar, erythritol, spices and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes over low heat, stirring often, until the sauce has reduced by half.
Blend until fine with an immersion blender, then strain through a sieve for a perfectly smooth ketchup.
Let cool and pour into a sterilized jar.
l10-ketchup-keto.p: Keeps for 2 weeks in the refrigerator. Kids love it with the cauliflower bites.

l10-vinaigrette-moutarde-ancienne.t: Whole-Grain Mustard and Apple Cider Vinaigrette
s: In a jar, put the mustard, vinegar, grated garlic, salt and pepper.
Close and shake to dissolve the salt.
Add the olive oil, close again and shake vigorously for 20 seconds until emulsified.
Add the chives just before serving and shake again.
l10-vinaigrette-moutarde-ancienne.p: Make a batch for the week without the chives. Shake before each use.

s: Grate the cucumber with the skin on, salt it and let it drain in a colander for 10 minutes.
Squeeze it firmly by hand to remove as much water as possible.
Mix the yogurt with the grated garlic, lemon juice, mint and dill.
Stir in the cucumber, drizzle with olive oil and chill for 30 minutes.
l10-tzatziki-concombre.p: Squeezing the cucumber well keeps the tzatziki from being runny. Keeps for 3 days.

s: Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice: it will thicken and seize up, which is normal.
Gradually add the cold water, whisking, until the sauce is smooth and coats a spoon.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and salt.
Sprinkle with parsley when serving.
l10-sauce-tahini-citron.p: Adjust the texture with water: thicker as a dip, thinner for drizzling over roasted cauliflower.

s: Mix the lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Pour in the oils in a stream, whisking.
Add the cilantro just before serving.
Pour over a tomato-cucumber salad or grilled vegetables.
l10-vinaigrette-argan-citron.p: Argan oil is delicate: don't heat it, and store it away from light.

l10-pesto-roquette-noix.t: Arugula Pesto with Walnuts and Feta
s: Blend the walnuts and garlic into a coarse powder.
Add the arugula, crumbled feta and lemon juice, and pulse.
Pour in the oil in a stream with the blender running, until the sauce is uniform.
Season with pepper and taste: the feta provides the salt.
l10-pesto-roquette-noix.p: Perfect on zucchini noodles or grilled chicken breast. Keeps for 4 days covered with oil.

s: Heat the cream over low heat in a saucepan without letting it boil.
Add the cream cheese and whisk until melted.
Stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until the sauce is smooth, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the mustard, paprika and nutmeg, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over broccoli or cauliflower, or as a dip.
l10-sauce-fromagere-cheddar.p: It thickens as it cools: reheat gently with a spoonful of cream.

l10-cafe-keto-beurre.t: Keto Butter Coffee with Coconut Oil
s: Brew a very hot coffee.
Pour it into a blender with the butter, coconut oil and cinnamon.
Blend for 20 seconds until frothy and creamy, like a latte.
Sweeten with stevia if needed and drink right away.
l10-cafe-keto-beurre.p: Without a blender, use a milk frother. Start with half the amount of fat if you're not used to it.

l10-smoothie-vert-avocat-epinard.t: Green Avocado, Spinach and Cucumber Smoothie
s: Wash the spinach and cut the cucumber into pieces.
Put all the ingredients in the blender, almond milk first.
Blend for 1 minute on full power until perfectly smooth.
Add a few ice cubes and blend for another 10 seconds. Serve immediately.
l10-smoothie-vert-avocat-epinard.p: Add 1 tbsp chia seeds for a more filling smoothie.

s: Put the yogurt, cold water, cream, erythritol and cardamom in the blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until frothy.
Pour over ice into two glasses.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios and serve well chilled.
l10-lassi-keto-cardamome.p: Savory version: replace the erythritol with a pinch of salt and toasted cumin.

s: In a saucepan, whisk the cocoa and erythritol with 3 tbsp of the almond milk to form a smooth paste.
Add the rest of the milk and the cream, then heat over medium heat, whisking.
Add the chopped dark chocolate and whisk until melted, without boiling.
Off the heat, add the vanilla and the pinch of salt.
Froth with a whisk or immersion blender and serve piping hot.
l10-chocolat-chaud-keto.p: A pinch of cinnamon or chili makes a spiced version. Ideal for kids' afternoon snack in winter.

l10-citronnade-stevia-menthe.t: Homemade Lemonade with Stevia and Mint
s: Squeeze the lemons and strain the juice.
Dissolve the stevia in 100 ml of water, whisking.
Pour into a pitcher with the lemon juice, the remaining water and the lightly bruised mint leaves.
Refrigerate for 1 hour and serve over ice.
l10-citronnade-stevia-menthe.p: Replace half of the water with sparkling water when serving for a fizzy version.

l10-eau-aromatisee-concombre-menthe.t: Cucumber, Lemon and Mint Infused Water
s: Wash the cucumber and lemon, then cut them into thin slices.
Lightly bruise the mint leaves between your hands to release their aroma.
Put everything in a pitcher and cover with cold water.
Let infuse for 2 hours in the refrigerator and serve over ice.
l10-eau-aromatisee-concombre-menthe.p: Refill the pitcher with water once during the day, then replace the fruit. Drink within 24 hours.

l10-golden-milk-coco.t: Golden Milk with Turmeric and Coconut Milk
s: Pour the almond milk and coconut milk into a saucepan.
Add the turmeric, cinnamon, ginger and black pepper, which helps the body absorb the turmeric.
Heat for 5 minutes over low heat, whisking, without boiling.
Strain, sweeten with stevia and froth before serving.
l10-golden-milk-coco.p: Careful, turmeric stains: rinse the pan and cups right away.
